We are a non-profit association with a keen interest and active involvement in science, based in the Garching area. We collaborate on the GraviHAB project, which focuses on habitat design, mobile plant cultivation, biomass recycling, and artificial gravity. In addition to habitat design and hardware testing, our work examines aspects such as seed selection and efficiency; plant lighting systems; the simplified composition and delivery of nutrient solutions; leaf and root respiration and their impact on air composition; biomass methanization and improved biogas-to-electricity conversion; the suitability of plant produce for human consumption; and the benefits and risks associated with the biome developing within our partially or fully closed habitat.

Our goal is twofold: to offer students the opportunity to conduct research on these topics free of charge, and to develop our own ideas and solutions—thereby fostering knowledge exchange in areas such as human space exploration, disaster and crisis relief, or local food supply.

Polimak Space S.A. is a Luxembourg-based company founded by seasoned space-technology and material-handling experts. By transposing decades of terrestrial material handling and conveying technology experience into the space sector, we develop solutions for the efficient and safe handling of regolith. Our patented Modular Drum Conveyor (MDC) and vertical conveying technologies are designed to operate reliably on the lunar surface, integrated into rovers, landers, and regolith processing units to enable end-to-end ISRU operations.

Our core technology is defined by a mechanical approach that is intentionally simple yet highly efficient and powerful. Unlike complex alternatives, our systems are inherently scalable and require extremely low maintenance, making them the ideal technology to engage in rigorous, long-term ISRU (In-Situ Resource Utilization) activities. By prioritizing mechanical reliability, Polimak Space provides the robust infrastructure necessary to bridge the gap between lunar excavation and resource processing.

A defining feature of our system is its modular component architecture, which allows for the seamless integration of:
- Sensors and Monitoring: For real-time data on material flow and composition.

- Sieving and Mixing Technologies: Enabling the precise preconditioning and beneficiation of regolith.

- Stockpiling and Delivery: Facilitating organized storage and transport for construction or thermal energy storage.

By prioritizing mechanical reliability and modularity, Polimak Space provides the robust infrastructure necessary for regolith beneficiation—a critical step in converting raw lunar soil into usable resources—bridging the gap between excavation and final processing.

entityDescription: The Landbanking Group is a Munich-based nature fintech company on a mission to stop and reverse nature loss by making nature investable: turning it from a cost into an asset class.⁠ ⁠Founded in 2022, the company is building the infrastructure for an economy indexed on nature, grounded in the conviction that nature is humanity's most critical infrastructure and must be visible, valued, and integrated into business and investment decisions.⁠ Its core product, Landler (landler.io), is the world's first end-to-end natural capital management platform: it fuses satellite remote sensing, in-field measurements (eDNA, bioacoustics, soil) and process-based and ML models into nature condition scores and natural capital accounts at fine spatial resolution, measuring outcomes across biodiversity, carbon, water, and soil.⁠ Builging on top of these MRV layers, The Landbanking Group develops economic models of risk and resilience and facilitates various financial investment pathways.⁠

entityDescription: Retrüv Ltd is an early-stage UK company (SIC 62012) building a provenance, authentication and regulatory-compliance platform based on Digital Product Passports. The platform captures verified evidence of a product's origin, materials and chain of custody, binds it to the physical item through NFC authentication (NTAG 424 DNA) and GS1 Digital Link identifiers, and anchors it in a signed, append-only transparency log so that provenance becomes independently verifiable rather than self-declared. It spans seven modules covering origin and supplier intelligence, marking, secure record-keeping, authentication, ownership, resale and regulatory intelligence. Retrüv addresses the verification and due-diligence obligations created by EU regulation, including the ESPR/Digital Product Passport framework, the Deforestation Regulation and corporate sustainability due diligence, anchored initially in premium fashion and extending across natural-fibre and agricultural-commodity supply chains.

entityDescription:
Nexus Dynamix is a deep-tech company specializing in microgravity simulation hardware, automated real-time control software, and terrestrial microgravity environment replication. The company's core technology platform, AstroPod, is a patented, high-precision mechatronic instrument designed to provide on-demand, sustained low-gravity environments (<0.008g) within standard laboratory workflows.
Unlike conventional analog clinostats that rely on blind, continuous rotation (introducing disruptive fluid shear stresses that damage crystal formation) our technology employs an AI-driven, multi-axis active nullification system. By utilizing custom real-time sensor loops and precision motion platforms, the platform dynamically maps local ambient gravity fields and cancels acceleration vectors. This active intervention delivers a motionless, highly stable space-grade physical environment on Earth with zero destructive vibrations.
The entity operates at a demonstrated Technology Readiness Level of TRL 7, backed by multiple filed US provisional patent applications covering both the physical hardware mechanics and the environmental simulation control loops. Nexus Dynamix actively develops advanced mechatronics, predictive simulation frameworks (digital twins), and material gravity-response datasets. Our primary objectives within the European Space Agency ecosystem are to expand downstream application capabilities, advance our digital twin modeling toward true orbital-range microgravity performance (<0.001g), and collaborate with aerospace partners on high-value crystal growth, structural biology, and advanced materials initiatives.
